steps.what: Conduct neuropsychological evaluations and interpret performance in clinical context

tasks.design: Retain test administration, observation and interpretation with the neuropsychologist. Existing {DOCS} holds test guidance; report composition is counted separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Performance needs interpretation alongside effort, language and clinical context.
tasks.enabler_now: No reduction in evaluation time is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing impairment from other influences on performance.

evidence.claim: Clinical administration and interpretation cannot be replaced by automatic report composition in this design.

assumptions: Scope includes evaluation, not separately counted report writing.
No free structured scores or validity flags are assumed; current assessment work remains counted.
Use existing test tools; no new software.
No incremental maintenance because the evaluation process is unchanged.
unknowns: Test battery and current scoring tools
research_questions: Is any scoring still manually repeated after administration?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0%. Existing scoring runtime earns no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select verified tests, observations and clinical conclusions for detailed reports
Write source-linked clinical reports without adding diagnoses or recommendations

loop.purpose: Draft report prose around clinician-supplied findings
loop.input: Checked source pack and report template
loop.check: Compare every statement, qualifier, score and attribution with source evidence and clinician conclusions
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported or conflicting content is written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative synthesis varies across observations and interviews; templates alone cannot compose it

steps.what: Review clinical meaning and accept the exact final neuropsychological report

tasks.design: Use a controlled {DOCS} template and a bounded drafting loop over a clinician-checked source pack. The neuropsychologist verifies meaning, omissions and clinical conclusions before accepting the exact report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative composition combines heterogeneous source material.
tasks.enabler_now: Speech-driven clinical reporting exists, but this proposal only drafts from verified source material.
tasks.still_hard: Preserving uncertainty and avoiding unsupported clinical inferences.
tasks.human_edge: The clinician determines and defends the clinical interpretation.

reach.learn: How readers understand uncertainty and limitations

evidence.claim: Medendo, ValueCare and Autoscriber are named in the digest as speech-driven reporting tools used in Dutch mental health care; this is adjacent reporting capability, not neuropsychological diagnostic validation.
The proposed source-pack drafting workflow and time estimate remain unmeasured.

assumptions: Evaluation and patient interviewing are separate tasks; their findings exist only after the clinician performs those tasks.

In s1 the neuropsychologist captures and checks patient identifier, encounter date, test name and version, verified scores, source locations, observations, conclusions and limitations. This source preparation takes 25%; missing material is completed manually, never inferred.
Try existing document templates and authorised clinical drafting features before custom integration.
No automatic diagnosis, scoring validity decision or external report dispatch occurs. Access and patient-data arrangements require local confirmation.
unknowns: Time spent on composition versus interpretation
research_questions: Does source-linked drafting reduce total time after full clinical verification?

incremental.description: Template maintenance and additional quality sampling

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient, report text, scores, sources, conclusions and limitations; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=86.5, gross=13.5%; minus 5 focal upkeep gives net 8.5%. Range 0-4% allows substantial manual rewriting of complex clinical narratives; E1 scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Interview patients, clarify histories and check uncertain accounts sensitively

tasks.design: Retain the medical history interview and contemporaneous clinical understanding with the neuropsychologist. Existing {DOCS} can support prompts, while report composition is handled separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Accounts may be incomplete, uncertain or affected by impairment.
tasks.enabler_now: No shortening of patient conversation is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising ambiguity and asking appropriate follow-up questions.

evidence.claim: Ambient documentation results do not establish that comprehensive history interviews can be shortened.

assumptions: Interviewing includes live clarification; separate report writing is not counted twice.
Patient history is produced through this interview, not assumed as a ready structured input.
Existing interview guidance remains; no new system.
No new upkeep because the process is unchanged.
research_questions: Which history topics most often require follow-up?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; no patient interaction is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Diagnose and treat central nervous system conditions

steps.what: Diagnose conditions and deliver appropriate neuropsychological treatment within professional scope

tasks.design: Keep clinical formulation and treatment with the neuropsychologist within their scope. Existing {DOCS} provides evidence and guidance; drafting assistance does not replace clinical decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Diagnosis and treatment depend on the full clinical picture.
tasks.enabler_now: No clinical decision automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Managing uncertainty and coordinating medical investigation or treatment with appropriate clinicians.
tasks.human_edge: Clinical judgement, explanation and therapeutic relationship.

reach.learn: Limits of inference from cognitive findings

evidence.claim: Report-writing tools do not establish safe automation of clinical diagnosis or treatment.

assumptions: Direct diagnosis and treatment only; report writing is separately counted.
Clinical findings come from completed clinical work, without free diagnosis or eligibility flags.
Use current clinical systems and guidance.
No incremental upkeep because no changed process is introduced.
research_questions: Where do clinical teams encounter missing evidence before formulation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; no clinical decision or treatment time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Clinical judgement with carefully checked reporting assistance
role.ambitious_version: Reports communicate the clinician's findings accurately without reducing assessment or treatment time.
